messages:
Maya Patel: quick q — in the latest mobile comps the 'Canary interrupted' state sits as a slim pill at the top of the timeline. on 320px it overlaps the timeline scrubber's grab area. screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/canary-interrupt-compact.png

Rina Soto: saw that. On small phones the scrubber is often thumb-first, so any overlay will cause accidental taps. Can we avoid covering the scrubber while keeping the state visible?

Theo - Eng: implementation constraints: we don't want to change the DOM order of the timeline for a11y reasons (voiceover/screenreader expects timeline before ephemeral banners). we could absolutely position the pill above but add timeline padding, or convert the pill to a right-anchored toast inside the timeline header region.

Maya Patel: i prefer right-anchored toast — less vertical shift. But we also need to handle very narrow private consoles that have <360px content width; toast should collapse to full-width and sit above the header instead of overlapping controls.

Omar - PM: copy options: (A) "Canary interrupted — traffic routed to stable" (B) "Canary interrupted by policy — traffic routed" (C) "Canary paused — view details" Thoughts? we should be explicit when automated safety triggered it.

Rina Soto: prefer A + a tiny secondary tag that says "Automated" or "Manual" depending on source. keep primary line short so it scans at a glance.

Theo - Eng: a11y notes: toasts must be announced via aria-live="assertive" for urgent state changes, but we need to avoid interrupting ongoing screenreader interactions. maybe aria-atomic and polite for less severe states. For interrupted canaries (safety triggered) i'd argue assertive.

accessibility-bot: reminder: color contrast target 4.5:1 for body copy; 3:1 permitted for decorative larger type.

Maya Patel: visual contrast — current pill is pale orange on white; low contrast on 12px secondary text. Rina, can you try darker text or darker background? add :warning: icon to left.

Rina Soto: will try bg #FFEECC with 14px bold primary and 12px secondary. If secondary still fails, I'll switch to #FFD89A. Will push alternate swatches. Also proposing small divider between primary and action to avoid hitbox confusion.

Theo - Eng: interaction: 'Undo' should be an inline button on the toast. But for accidental taps we can make the Undo a two-tap flow: first tap shows an inline confirmation microdialog ("Are you sure? Undo canary interruption" with Confirm/Cancel). Non-blocking and quick. Keyboard users: provide visible focus ring and visible text for screen readers.

Omar - PM: metrics to track: toast_shown, toast_action_undo_clicked, undo_confirmed, undo_failed. Also we need to measure layout_shift_score when toast appears on mobile.

Maya Patel: accessibility flow question — when toast appears, will keyboard focus move to it? i'd prefer not to steal focus; instead leave focus where user was. provide a skip link visible on focus to jump to Undo.

Theo - Eng: agree — don't auto-focus. Provide an offscreen skip link with visible-on-focus styles: `a.skip-to-toast { position: absolute; left: -9999px; } a.skip-to-toast:focus { left: 8px; top: 8px; }`. Also set toast tabindex="-1" so it's not in normal tab order unless user uses skip.

Rina Soto: microcopy proposal for toast: line1: "Canary interrupted" line2 (smaller): "Traffic routed to stable — paused automatically" CTA primary: "Undo" tertiary: "Details" (opens rollout inspector).

Maya Patel: motion: slide in from right with reduced-motion respect. On reduced-motion user set `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` we should fade instead of slide. Also ensure the animation duration is <= 200ms.

Theo - Eng: small technical detail: dedicated/private consoles sometimes have custom CSS resets that kill `prefers-reduced-motion`. we'll add explicit class toggle from JS when we detect the media query. fallback ok.

accessibility-bot: checklist: aria-live appropriate, skip-to-toast present, keyboard focus visible, contrast >= 4.5:1 for 12px body, animation respects reduced-motion.

Omar - PM: next steps: Rina to update comps with right-anchored toast + darker swatch + icon + two-line copy; Theo to prototype tabindex plan + undo confirm microdialog; Maya to add QA checklist and instrument events in ticket; ship target: next sprint.

Maya Patel: tagging folks, will upload refreshed frames tonight and add link to prototype in the ticket. thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
